achievements.description: Finish Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Finish Episode 1: Chrysalis.

steps.text: Play through Episode 1: Chrysalis to the end.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #1 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the first optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: etched desk markings.

steps.text: In the classroom, before you leave, check the carved graffiti on the desk ahead of yours and shoot it.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #2 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the second optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: Blackwell statue.

steps.text: After the fire alarm, outside on the quad, walk up to the statue of @npc{Jeremiah Blackwell} and take its photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #3 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the third optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: fallen skater.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Justin} near the skaters. Whatever you say, he calls you a poser.
@mechanic{Rewind} and talk to him again. Show you are not a poser with the new options.
When he offers a nose-slide or a tre flip, pick the tre flip.
After the skater falls, walk up to him and take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #4 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the fourth optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: squirrel by the tree.

steps.text: In front of the dorm, @npc{Kate} sits on a bench. Go to the tree in front of her and take a photo of the squirrel beside it.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #5 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the fifth optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: mirror selfie.

steps.text: In your dorm room, look in the small mirror by the door and take the selfie.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #6 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the sixth optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: Victoria's wall photos.

steps.text: Go into @npc{Victoria}'s room.
Mess up the photos on the wall by the door, then take a photo of them.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #7 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the seventh optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: broken window.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: Outside the dorm, let the football hit @npc{Alyssa}, then @mechanic{rewind}.
Warn Alyssa so the ball breaks a window instead.
Take a photo of the broken window.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #8 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the eighth optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: RV window writing.

steps.text: In the parking lot, go to the dusty RV in the far corner.
Write on the dirty window, then take a photo of the writing.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #9 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the ninth optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: bird on a rock.

steps.text: On the way to the lighthouse with @npc{Chloe}, turn around before you walk up the hill.
Photograph the bird perched on the rock beside the path.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #10 in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Take the tenth optional photo in Episode 1: Chrysalis: Chloe at the lighthouse.

steps.text: Walk up the hill to the bench where @npc{Chloe} sits.
Before you talk to her, stand behind her and take the photo.

achievements.description: Take all optional photos in Episode 1: Chrysalis
achievements.summary: Collect all ten optional photos from Episode 1: Chrysalis.

guide.context: If you miss a photo, replay that part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. This keeps your story choices. You can also restart the story from any point.

achievements.description: Finish Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Finish Episode 2: Out of Time.

steps.text: Play through Episode 2: Out of Time to the end.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #1 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the first optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: rabbit in its cage.

steps.text: When you return @npc{Kate}'s book, go to the rabbit cage on your left and take a photo of the rabbit.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #2 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the second optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: squirrel on the bench.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: After you leave the girls' dorm, go to the trash can next to the bench on the right.
Pull the candy bar out of the bin and set it on the bench.
Back off a few steps. When the squirrel hops up to eat, move in close and shoot.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #3 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the third optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: Two Whales sign.

steps.text: At the diner entrance, look up at the whale sign above the door and take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #4 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the fourth optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: dog behind the diner.

steps.text: Walk around the right side of the diner to the back alley and the fence.
Look at the dog sitting by the RV and take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #5 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the fifth optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: bathroom mirror writing.

steps.text: Inside the diner, go to the bathroom and look at the writing carved in the mirror.
Take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #6 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the sixth optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: school bus.

steps.text: In the junkyard, after @npc{Chloe} asks you to find bottles, walk to the front of the old yellow bus.
Stand by the tires and shoot the bus.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #7 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the seventh optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: deer.

steps.text: Go to the clearing behind the school bus and find the deer.
Take the photo once it stops running.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #8 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the eighth optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: Chloe on the car hood.

steps.text: After the bottle shooting with @npc{Chloe}, she lies on the hood of the car.
Walk to her left side and take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #9 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the ninth optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: Warren's experiment.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: In the science room, talk to @npc{Warren}. Whatever chemical you pick, it fails.
@mechanic{Rewind} and ask the teacher about the experiment. She says to use chlorine.
Tell Warren to use chlorine with the third dialogue option.
When the experiment works, take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #10 in Episode 2: Out of Time
achievements.summary: Take the tenth optional photo in Episode 2: Out of Time: Alyssa by the window.

steps.text: In the photography classroom, stand behind @npc{Alyssa} at the window and take the photo.

achievements.description: Take all optional photos in Episode 2: Out of Time

achievements.description: Finish Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Finish Episode 3: Chaos Theory.

steps.text: Play through Episode 3: Chaos Theory to the end.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #1 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the first optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: glowing figurine.

steps.text: Once @npc{Taylor} says @npc{Victoria} is gone, enter Victoria's room.
Hold your camera light on the glowing figure on her shelf for a few seconds, then shoot it.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #2 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the second optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: squirrel on the bench.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: After you leave the dorms, go right to the bench with the squirrel.
It runs away when you get close, so @mechanic{rewind} and take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #3 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the third optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: aquarium.

steps.text: In the science room, turn on the light of the fish tank by the window.
Take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #4 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the fourth optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: skeleton with a cigarette.

steps.text: At the back of the science room, take a photo of the skeleton with the cigarette in its mouth.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #5 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the fifth optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: Chloe in the chair.

steps.text: In the principal's office, line up the bronze hawk and @npc{Chloe} in the chair.
Take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #6 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the sixth optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: bathroom selfie.

steps.text: After you change into @npc{Rachel}'s clothes, leave the bedroom and go to the bathroom.
Take the selfie in the mirror.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #7 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the seventh optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: bird on the fence.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: After you help make breakfast and before you sit to eat, open the window next to the table.
Scare the bird on the cabinet once so it flies to the fireplace.
Scare it again so it flies out of the window.
Leave by the sliding door into the yard and photograph the bird now on the fence.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #8 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the eighth optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: semi truck.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: Outside the diner, talk to the trucker. He tells you what his truck is.
@mechanic{Rewind} and talk to him again. Use the truck model (1977 Needham) as your answer.
Turn to the other side of the road and take a photo of his truck.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #9 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the ninth optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: ants and dead bird.

steps.text: After the truck photo outside the diner, walk to the diner's right-hand side.
Photograph the dead bird covered in ants.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #10 in Episode 3: Chaos Theory
achievements.summary: Take the tenth optional photo in Episode 3: Chaos Theory: young Chloe and her father.

steps.text: After the jump back in time you land in the kitchen with young @npc{Chloe} and her father.
Take the camera lying by the sink and shoot the pair.

achievements.description: Finish Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Finish Episode 4: Dark Room.

steps.text: Play through Episode 4: Dark Room to the end.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #1 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the first optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room: Chloe at her desk.

steps.text: Back in the original timeline, @npc{Chloe} is seated at the desk. Photograph her straight away.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #2 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the second optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room: bird's nest.

steps.text: In the garage near the door, move the plank or desk that covers the bird's nest.
Take a photo of the nest with the eggs.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #3 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the third optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room: pile of rocks.

steps.text: Outside the girls' dorm, once you have spoken with @npc{Jefferson}, follow the path to the yard corner by the totem pole.
Photograph the stack of stones there.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #4 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the fourth optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room: two squirrels.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Samuel} and mention animals, then squirrels. He feeds one squirrel.
Pick the food up from beside him and use the @mechanic{Lure} option to bring the second squirrel.
When both squirrels sit next to each other, take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #5 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the fifth optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room: footprints at the window.

steps.text: In the boys' dorm, walk to the hallway's last window.
Photograph the animal tracks in the snow outside.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #6 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the sixth optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room: dead whales.

steps.text: At the beach, before you go to @npc{Frank}'s camp, walk to the barrier by the whales.
Take a photo of a dead whale.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #7 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the seventh optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room: bird on the fence.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: Outside the barn, before you enter, photograph the bird sitting on the fence.
If it flies away, @mechanic{rewind} to bring it back.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #8 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the eighth optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room: owl in the barn.

steps.text: Climb to the upper floor of the barn.
Walk to the sleeping owl by the hay and take its photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #9 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the ninth optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room.

steps.text: The party holds the last two photos of the episode, and each fills one of the two remaining slots. One shows the two moons through the high windows by the trampoline. The other shows @npc{Justin} beside the skeleton graffiti in the restroom near the VIP entrance.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #10 in Episode 4: Dark Room
achievements.summary: Take the tenth optional photo in Episode 4: Dark Room.

achievements.description: Finish Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Finish Episode 5: Polarized.

steps.text: Play through Episode 5: Polarized to the end.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #1 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the first optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: Kate in the classroom.

steps.text: After you wake in the classroom, walk to @npc{Kate} and pick @mechanic{Comfort}.
After the talk, take a photo of her.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #2 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the second optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: girl in the gallery.

steps.text: In the gallery, go right and down the stairs to the lower level.
Take a photo of the red-haired girl sitting with her back to you. Her camera lies next to her.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #3 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the third optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: last picture request.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: In the dark room, after @npc{David} interrupts @npc{Jefferson}, @mechanic{rewind} as far back as you can.
When the talk replays, pick the option to take one last picture.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #4 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the fourth optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: dead whale on the road.

steps.text: Once the diner is saved, turn around and photograph the beached whale in the road.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #5 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the fifth optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: car on the roof.

steps.text: Right after the whale photo, face the neighbouring building that has a car on its roof.
Stand just left of it, then take the photo before you enter the diner.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #6 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the sixth optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: etched desk markings.

steps.text: When you are in the classroom again, inspect the carved graffiti on the desk before you, twice if needed.
Take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #7 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the seventh optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: giant squirrels.

steps.text: In the dorm hallway puzzle, you become @npc{Victoria}, then Max again.
Take the side passage on your right and photograph the huge squirrels outside its window.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #8 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the eighth optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: skeleton in the backward school.

guide.context: If you miss this photo, replay this part of the episode from the main menu in collectible mode. Your story choices stay the same.

steps.text: When the school runs in reverse, go down the hall and take the right turn to the corner skeleton.
The photo prompt looks as if it is already taken. @mechanic{Rewind} to the right moment, then take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #9 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the ninth optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: Warren's locker.

steps.text: In the locker stealth section with @npc{Warren}, go left around the first lockers and turn right at the next ones.
After @npc{Samuel} walks by, turn right twice more to reach Warren's locker.
Open the locker and take the photo.

achievements.description: Take optional photo #10 in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Take the tenth optional photo in Episode 5: Polarized: five bottles.

steps.text: In the junkyard nightmare, find five bottles. Four sit on the orange cars in the corners; the fifth is in a room with a chair.
Take a photo of the five bottles on the desk near the end.

achievements.description: Take all optional photos in Episode 5: Polarized
achievements.summary: Collect all ten optional photos from Episode 5: Polarized.

collectibles.name: Skeleton in the backward school
collectibles.method: When the school runs in reverse, go down the hall and take the right turn to the corner skeleton. The photo prompt looks as if it is already taken. @mechanic{Rewind} to the right moment, then take the photo.

collectibles.name: Warren's locker
collectibles.method: In the locker stealth section with @npc{Warren}, go left around the first lockers and turn right at the next ones. After @npc{Samuel} walks by, turn right twice more to reach Warren's locker. Open the locker and take the photo.

collectibles.name: Five bottles
collectibles.method: In the junkyard nightmare, find five bottles. Four sit on the orange cars in the corners; the fifth is in a room with a chair. Take a photo of the five bottles on the desk near the end.
